bio_facts: That Boy Hi Hat is an alternative rap artist defining Post-Trap Futurism, managed by Cumulative Web Inc (Henry Pitts / Black Lansky).
Catalog: 24 unique Spotify tracks; flagship single "Zooted Zone" (~307,000 lifetime Spotify plays, baseline 2026-09-14).
Latest single "Diabolique" released 2026-07-03; produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black Lansky; recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington, VA (owner-confirmed 2026-09-15).
Three tracks verified holding on Audiartist's "New Rap Hits" playlist (673 followers): Shaka Zulu #21, Zooted Zone #30, Doves & Diamonds #31 (full scan 2026-09-15).
Producers on record: Kokurcho (Zooted Zone), Hybrid (Diabolique; mixed/mastered Zooted Zone), Jeck Da General (Flamerz) — all owner-confirmed.
Flagship tracks are explicit; no clean/FCC-safe versions or licensable instrumentals are documented.
